actual_native_update.moments: ordinary raw exponential averages with Adam bias correction
actual_native_update.amsgrad: maximum of raw second moment, then divide by current bias correction
actual_native_update.rms_denominator: same AMSGrad debiased square-root denominator plus epsilon used for parameter update
actual_native_update.weight_decay_learning_rate: nominal learning rate, not clipped learning rate
